findings.issue: Hiphil sequential perfect 2mp of H3423 with the land as direct object licenses taking possession of or dispossessing the land. “echen” means throw or cast, so the land is expelled.
Qal infinitive of H3423 leaves possess, seize, and inherit open. “heredar” selects inheritance.

notes: 2mp address as ustedes, dwelling in it, and “I gave you the land” match the remaining tokens.
